title: iPermit Spatial Detection Result
description: Auto-detected jurisdictions and environmental overlays for an uploaded project footprint, before consultant review and confirmation. See AGENTS.md GIS Strategy / GIS Intake Strategy and EPIC-05. Boundary parsing is T05-02; the spatial store is T05-01; jurisdiction/overlay detection is T05-03/T05-04; the review-and-confirm workflow is T05-06.

footprint_ref.description: Opaque pointer to the uploaded geometry (shapefile/KMZ). Absent when the result is from manual entry with no route file (AGENTS.md fallback).

detected_at.description: Date the detection was produced. Drives the evaluation_date used downstream.

jurisdictions.description: Detected applicable jurisdictions, Federal down to the most specific. Empty is valid for an early-stage project entered manually.

jurisdiction_id.description: Canonical jurisdiction_id (T00-08 grammar), matching a registered jurisdiction.

detection_source.description: How this jurisdiction entered the detection. User edits at confirmation time (T05-06) are tracked separately in the override log.

overlays.description: Detected environmental overlays as geometry.* leaf name -> value (e.g. fema_floodplain: true). The field registry is owned by T05-04; additional properties are allowed so new overlays do not require a schema bump.
